claims.text: Many reviewers report noticeable growth and thickening of eyelashes and eyebrows after using the product nightly.
Reviewers frequently praise the product for moisturizing and improving dry skin, hair, and cuticles.
Several reviewers highlight the product's affordability and good value.
One reviewer complains the oil arrived clear and odorless, suggesting it may be old or not as pictured, and is returning it.
One reviewer notes the consistency is thinner than a previous brand and prefers the thicker one.
